ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs), managers, and authorised representatives against the consolidated UN Security Council sanctions list, EU consolidated financial sanctions list (EU Regulation 269/2014 and related regulation), OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) list for USD transactions, EU High-Risk Third Countries list, national Luxembourg list under the Law of 12 November 2004, and domestic Politically Exposed Persons (PEP) lists. Expect customer due diligence under Article 3(a) of the Law of 12 November 2004, including PEP risk rating, source-of-funds verification, adverse media checks, and ongoing transaction monitoring. All triggering obligations must be reported to the Luxembourg Financial Intelligence Unit (Cellule de Renseignements Financiers, CRF) with mandatory filing of suspicious transaction reports under Article 5 of the same law.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) - Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) via lbr.lu / e-RCS portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names may be submitted in a language that can be expressed in Latin characters; Luxembourgish, French, German, and English are commonly accepted. The legal form designation 'Société à responsabilité limitée' or its acceptable abbreviations 'SARL' or 'S.à r.l.' must appear in full or abbreviated form in or after the corporate name. Names composed of non-Latin scripts (e.g., Cyrillic, Arabic, Mandarin characters) must be accompanied by a Latin-script transliteration. The name must comply with Luxembourg public order and must not create likelihood of confusion with an existing or reserved corporate name in the RCS.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Fonds commun de placement, SICAV, SICAF, FCP, Investment fund
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the RCS rejects a proposed name, the applicant shall file a formal written application for reconsideration with the Luxembourg Business Registers within 15 working days of the rejection notification, setting out the grounds of distinctiveness and non-conflict with existing registrations. If the LBR maintains the refusal, an action for annulment may be brought before the Tribunal d'arrondissement de Luxembourg, Commercial Chamber, within one month from the date of notification of final rejection, pursuant to the general rules of Luxembourg civil procedure. During the appeal period, the rejected name remains excluded from any reservation.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office or domiciliation address is permitted as the statutory registered office only if provided by an undertaking holding an authorisation under the Luxembourg law on commercial domiciliation. However, for the present manufacturing scope under ISIC 3250 (sterile nitrile examination gloves), a virtual office alone does not satisfy commercial substance requirements; real operational premises for production, stock, and personnel must exist in Luxembourg and be verifiable from the registered office records. The registered office must be a physical address in Luxembourg.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Approximately 15% annual probability of unannounced physical on-site inspection for an ordinary Low_Risk_Standard SARL, but this probability materially increases if there are inconsistencies in substance documentation, social security or VAT inspection triggers, or adverse intelligence from the CRF or customs authorities.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Amended Law of 10 August 1915 on Commercial Companies, as amended by the Law of 10 August 2016; Articles 100-1 to 100-23 (SARL), Article 100-2 (minimum capital), and Article 110-1 (registered office).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Luxembourg Trade and Companies Register (Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés, RCS), operated by the Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Notarised deed of incorporation (acte constitutif), RCS e-registration form, and RESA (Recueil électronique des sociétés et associations) publication.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Minimum subscribed capital for a SARL is EUR 12,000, fully subscribed and fully paid up at incorporation; the capital must be deposited in a blocked account (compte bloqué) with a Luxembourg credit institution and released by the notary only upon RCS registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: First Board Resolution of LU_SARL. In accordance with Articles 100-1 and 100-9 of the amended Law of 10 August 1915 on Commercial Companies, the shareholder and the newly appointed manager, acting as the constitutive body of the SARL, resolve: (1) the entire share capital has been subscribed and paid in as certified by the blocked-account certificate; (2) the registered office is established in Luxembourg at [address], and the owner's consent is accepted; (3) [Name] is appointed sole manager (gérant) with full and unlimited individual signature power; (4) the articles of association are approved and adopted; and (5) the manager is authorised to complete the RCS registration and all statutory filing formalities. Unanimously adopted.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Reservation and Capital Blocking
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) online portal and a Luxembourg credit institution
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a corporate name reservation via the LBR web portal and simultaneously open a blocked share-capital account with a Luxembourg bank; deposit the minimum EUR 12,000 and obtain a banker's certificate addressed to the notary confirming that the funds are irrevocably reserved for incorporation.
required_dossiers: Founders' passports and proof of residential address
Business plan covering ISIC 3250 nitrile glove production
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the LBR rejects the name, file a new name reservation; if the bank raises source-of-funds queries, submit transaction origin declarations, passport copies, and beneficial ownership information.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarisation of the Deed of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Have the notary authenticate the deed of incorporation. All founders must appear personally or by notarised proxy and approve the articles of association. The deed must specify the SARL legal form, share capital, corporate object covering sterile synthetic nitrile glove manufacture, registered office, and appointment of the first manager(s). The notary releases the blocked capital after registration.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary requests corrections, obtain shareholder consent by addendum and re-schedule the deed execution; any refusal by the notary is cured by executing a supplementary notarial statement.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: E-Filing and Registration with the RCS
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: RCS via the Luxembourg Business Registers e-filing platform
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The notary or an authorised agent submits the notarial deed and supporting forms through the LBR online portal within one month of signature. The RCS performs legal-form scrutiny, confirms that minimum capital and officer appointments comply, and issues the RCS registration number and official extract.
required_dossiers: RCS e-filing form signed by the manager
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RCS issues a deficiency notice (carence), submit the requested items through the portal within 15 days; if registration is refused, appeal to the Luxembourg District Court (Tribunal d'arrondissement).

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication in the Official Electronic Collection (RESA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers, Official Electronic Collection of Companies and Associations (RESA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Ensure the RCS automatically or through the notary publishes the incorporation particulars in RESA. Confirm that the formation deed, manager appointments, capital, registered office, and corporate object are visible and legally opposable to third parties.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If publication is delayed or contains errors, file a rectification application with the RCS and await a corrective RESA insertion.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Constitutive Governance Meeting and Bank Account Opening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered office in Luxembourg and the appointed manager(s)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first meeting of the manager and shareholder at the registered office; adopt the pro-forma first board resolution; approve the share subscription, choose the Luxembourg corporate bank, set the accounting reference year, and delegate daily management and signatory powers.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the manager fails to attend, obtain a unanimous written resolution in lieu of a meeting; if bank due-diligence is incomplete, provide beneficial-ownership declarations and updated RCS extract.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Registration Tax and Social Security Notifications
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AEDT); Joint Social Security Centre (Centre commun de la sécurité sociale, CNSS/CCSS)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the company for corporate income tax, municipal business tax, net wealth tax, and VAT through the MyGuichet.lu portal; register as an employer with the social security centre; obtain the national business registry number and, if required, an EORI number for EU trade in medical gloves.
required_dossiers: Anticipated turnover forecast for VAT thresholds
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax authority raises a query or audit, engage a Luxembourg tax advisor and submit statutory responses under the general taxation procedures; assessment disputes may be appealed within three months of notification.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of the Economy, Directorate-General for Industry (Direction générale de l'industrie); Ministry of Health, Directorate of Health (Direction de la Santé) for medical device manufacturing and PPE conformity
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Industrial establishment authorisation (autorisation d'établissement), classified-establishment environmental operating permit (établissement classé), and medical device / PPE manufacturing notification under Regulation (EU) 2017/745

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Luxembourg Environmental Protection Agency (Administration de l'environnement)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category A facility requiring a full environmental impact assessment (étude d'incidences) and a class-one classified-establishment authorisation because the nitrile dipping process uses solvents, coagulation chemistry, and generates VOC and wastewater discharges.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with Directive 2010/75/EU on industrial emissions; compliance with VOC solvent-emissions control thresholds under Directive 1999/13/EC; treated wastewater must meet Luxembourg discharge limits laid down by the Grand-Ducal Regulation on urban wastewater (règlement grand-ducal sur le déversement des eaux usées) before any municipal sewer release; waste-management obligations under the amended Law of 21 March 2017 on waste.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-safety certification from the Corps grand-ducal d'incendie et de secours (CGDIS); structural-load inspection certificate issued by an accredited Luxembourg bureau de contrôle; occupational health and safety clearance from the Inspection du Travail et des Mines (ITM) covering risk assessment, dipping-line guarding, ventilation, chemical exposure limits, and personal protective equipment protocols.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Administration des contributions directes (ACD) for direct taxation and Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AEDT) for indirect taxation; consolidated e-portal: MyGuichet.lu and Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR / RCS)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign investor establishing a Luxembourg Société à Responsabilité Limitée (SARL) must execute a notarised deed of incorporation and submit it to the RCS (Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés). Upon RCS registration, the ACD automatically attributes a 13-digit matricule (national tax identification number). For VAT purposes, the SARL must file a VAT registration form (Formulaire 1A) with the AEDT and obtain a Luxembourg VAT identification number (LU + 8 digits). The SARL must also register for social security as an employer if it hires staff. The entire procedure can be initiated online via MyGuichet.lu or through a notary.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Luxembourg does not operate a US-style check-the-box regime. However, a SARL may elect for VAT grouping (assujetti unique) with eligible related entities, may elect for fiscal integration (tax consolidation regime) of resident companies subject to 95% ownership and holding-period requirements, may opt into the EU ATAD hybrid mismatch rules and may elect to apply the Luxembourg patent box (IP tax regime) for qualifying intellectual property. Additionally, certain optional provisions exist for notional interest deduction taking, VAT recovery for holding companies, and intra-group financing arrangements under accepted transfer pricing documentation.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EUR 30,000 annual turnover exemption threshold for small businesses; above this threshold, VAT registration is generally mandatory. A foreign-established SARL with any taxable activity in Luxembourg must register before the first taxable transaction unless the small business turnover exemption is available.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Luxembourg does not currently impose mandatory B2B e-invoicing or a real-time fiscal clearance stamping regime. Electronic invoicing is permitted subject to buyer consent and authenticity guarantees (EDI or PEPPOL formats accepted). For B2G transactions, e-invoicing via PEPPOL is mandated under European Directive 2014/55/EU. Standard audit requirements include 10-year invoice retention and submission to AEDT in case of investigation.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods dispatched or transported to a destination outside the European Union are eligible for VAT zero-rating under the Luxembourg VAT law, provided the exporter retains the required evidence of export. Intra-EU dispatches of goods to a taxable person registered for VAT in another EU Member State are likewise zero-rated. Sterile examination nitrile gloves sold for export therefore qualify provided they are physically shipped out of the Union/intra-EU in accordance with commercial documentation and the buyer's valid VAT registration.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Déclaration en Douane / Export made via ICS/DUA)
Bill of Lading / Airway Bill / CMR transport document
Commercial Invoice with Incoterms and export VAT zero-rating reference
Invoice addressed to non-EU customer or EU customer with valid VAT ID
Intra-EU Sales List declaration and Recapitulative statement (for intra-EU dispatches)
Proof of transport and receipt by customer (signed CMR, customs stamp, or postal/courier receipt)
Inward Remittance Certificate confirming payment receipt
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The AEDT conducts risk-based audits of export zero-rating claims. If a taxpayer fails to produce sufficient documentary evidence of export within the prescribed deadline, the AEDT may reassess VAT at the standard rate of 17% plus default interest and administrative penalties. Fraudulent claims or deliberately falsified export documentation are subject to criminal fines up to EUR 10,000 or imprisonment under Luxembourg tax law; additional tax penalties of up to 10% of the tax evaded may apply. Retroactive clawback is limited to the statutory assessment period of ten years for VAT.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque centrale du Luxembourg (BCL) – monetary authority with sole competence for monetary statistics and balance-of-payments reporting; prudential banking supervision is exercised by the Commission de Surveillance du Secteur Financier (CSSF) under the Ministry of Finance umbrella. There is no separate foreign-exchange-control administration in Luxembourg.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Luxembourg maintains full convertibility of the euro for both current-account and capital-account transactions under the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union (Article 63 TFEU) and the Luxembourg Monetary Law of 1998. There are no exchange controls, surrender obligations, or prior-authorization licenses for profit remittance. Non-resident shareholders may freely receive dividends, interest, and liquidation proceeds after the applicable Luxembourg withholding tax (15% domestic; 0% under the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive or a Luxembourg tax treaty for qualifying corporate shareholders), subject only to standard bank-level KYC and BCL statistical reporting thresholds. Any restrictions derive solely from EU/UN sanctions or anti-money-laundering legal requirements, not from currency-account rules.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. Luxembourg does not impose any statutory timeline for repatriation of export proceeds and does not require mandatory conversion into euros. Exporters are free to hold export receipts in EUR or foreign currency accounts at licensed credit institutions or in overseas accounts provided the accounts are declared to the Luxembourg tax administration and the balance-of-payments statistics obligations (BCL/CSSF Circular 2011) are satisfied.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Banque et Caisse d'Épargne de l'État (BCEE)

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Multi-currency Operational Account and Trade Finance Facility
Corporate Treasury Account / Commercial LC Account
Settling Account / Depository Account for Capital Injection

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium – Luxembourg-authorized Electronic Money Institutions (e.g., Payoneer, Currencycloud, or local EMIs under PSD2) can provide euro-denominated e-money wallets, payment initiation, and cross-border settlement services for operational liquidity. However, EMIs are not licensed to take deposits or grant credit and are not appropriate for capital-escrow, large trade finance, commercial LC advising/confirming, or complex treasury hedging. Non-EU/offshore digital EMIs without a Luxembourg passport are not viable as principal banking rails due to the CSSF's requirement that payment services for Luxembourg-domiciled entities be rendered through EU-licensed or passporting institutions.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is generally mandatory for the legal entity's authorized signatories and for any individual holding 25% or more of the SARL's capital or Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) status. Remote video conferencing is permitted only as a supplementary confirmation step after a first in-person meeting, or for non-signatory employees and professional advisors in exceptional cases. Luxembourg banks require the SARL's senior managers or a locally resident director/authorized representative to attend an onboarding interview at the bank's premises in Luxembourg. Fully remote opening without any physical meeting is not offered by tier-1 commercial banks for a non-listed operational SARL.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Complex, non-transparent ownership chain involving multiple shareholdings or trusts
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified copy of the Luxembourg commercial register (via RCSL/Luxembourg Business Registers), organisational chart covering the full ownership chain, UBO declaration under Luxembourg AML law (Law of 12 November 2004, as amended), notarised shareholder register, and authenticated corporate resolutions for signatory authority.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source-of-wealth and source-of-funds enquiry for initial capital injection
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bank statements of the sole shareholder for the preceding 6–12 months, audited financial statements of the parent entity, tax certificates, share purchase agreement, dividend declarations or sale & purchase agreements explaining the origin of funds, and an signed indemnity/representation letter on source of wealth.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Medical/PPE-sector licensing compliance for sterile nitrile gloves manufacturing
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Valid Luxembourg Ministry of Health medical-device registration or European CE-mark documents, ISO 13485 certificate for the production facility, European Authorised Representative agreement (if applicable), sales contracts and pro-forma invoices demonstrating underlying trade, and any EU MDR import/export declarations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions or PEP status of counterparties in the trade corridor
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Completed sanctions/PEP screening questionnaire, counterparty passport or corporate extract, full commercial correspondence, transport and customs documents (Bill of Lading, EUR.1 or ATR certificates, customs declarations), and written confirmation that no product is destined for sanctioned entities or embargoed territories.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant wire transfer protocols for inbound shareholder capital: (i) transfer is sent via SWIFT MT103 from the parent company's corporate account, clearly referencing the beneficiary SARL's name, IBAN, and BIC in Luxembourg; (ii) the payment purpose must be notified to the receiving bank as 'Direct Investment – Equity Capital' using the BCL balance-of-payments harmonised purpose code D.1.1 (capital participation); (iii) the subscription deed, board resolution, and any shareholders' agreement must be pre-submitted to the Luxembourg bank's KYC unit; (iv) funds are credited to a capital-escrow or temporary blocked account, then released to the operational account upon the CSSF AML release and BCL statistical reporting (monthly or quarterly balance-of-payments reporting for transactions equal to or exceeding EUR 12,500); (v) if the contribution takes the form of a shareholder loan, the MT103 narrative must reference loan agreement and purpose code D.1.2/D.1.3, with the funds subject to the same verification.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary clearing rails: SEPA/SEPA Instant for EUR payments under EUR 100,000; SWIFT MT103 for TT wires in EUR, USD, or EUR-cross-border denominations; and commercial documentary Letters of Credit (LC) with SWIFT MT700/MT701 issuance, MT710/MT720 negotiation, and MT103 reimbursement for settlement of raw-material purchases of nitrile latex, packaging, and sterilization services. Luxembourg commercial banks provide LC advicing/confirmation through their international correspondent networks. Where the counterparty requires guaranteed settlement, a Bank Payment Obligation (BPO) on the Swift Trade Services Utility may be used as a complementary rail. All outbound payment instructions must carry the correct COFER/EBOPS purpose code for trade in goods (e.g., 'Services' vs 'Goods' codes) to meet BCL statistical reporting.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX forward (outright EUR/USD or EUR/CNH)
FX swap (swap of principal and interest between EUR and USD)
OTC FX option (European-style call/put on USD/EUR for trade-flow hedging)

Non-deliverable forward (NDF) for restricted-currency settlement only when the counterparty is outside China and the underlying is a non-convertible currency; NDF for EUR or USD is not market practice
Commodity-linked hedging is not required for nitrile gloves; only FX hedging is permissible

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Approval of annual accounts by the ordinary general meeting (AGO) and discharge of management
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General meeting of shareholders (AGO) - internal corporate organ; minutes recorded in the statutory minute book
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months after financial year-end; for a 31 December year-end SARL: by 30 June of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: No direct statutory penalty for the AGO itself; however, late approval delays the RCS filing and exposes managers to RCS fines and third-party damages; a shareholder may compel the AGO by court order.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Filing and publication of annual accounts with the Luxembourg Trade and Companies Register (RCS)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) via Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) electronic filing portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 1 month after AGO approval and in any case no later than 7 months after financial year-end; calendar-year SARL: hard deadline 31 July; EUR 19 electronic filing fee
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine of EUR 200 - EUR 2,500 per infraction under Article 171 of the Law of 19 December 2002; publication of the default in the register; persistent default may trigger RCS administrative strike-off proceedings; managers jointly and severally liable to third parties.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual confirmation of the beneficial owner (RBE / UBO) register declaration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs (RBE) - operated by Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Once per calendar year: within 30 days following the anniversary of the initial RBE declaration date; EUR 10 electronic confirmation fee; not a substitute for 30-day change reporting
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine of EUR 250 - EUR 2,500 per breach under Article 40 of the Law of 13 January 2019; while non-compliant, the SARL may be barred from profit distributions and from exercising certain member rights linked to RBE certification.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Collective corporate income tax, municipal business tax and net wealth tax return (Forms 400 / 400x)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Administration des contributions directes (ACD) - competent tax office for the SARL
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Statutory deadline: 31 December of the year following the tax year (calendar-year SARL: year N return filed by 31 December N+1); ACD filing reminder normally issued in Q2; extensions available electronically
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-payment interest of 0.6% per month (7.2% p.a.) on outstanding tax; late-filing surcharge up to 10% of the tax assessed; forced assessment with reversed burden of proof; criminal fines up to EUR 25,000 for deliberate misstatement.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Minimum net wealth tax (impôt sur la fortune - ISF) annual payment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Administration des contributions directes (ACD) - Collection Office (Recette)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual minimum: EUR 535 where total balance sheet is below EUR 350,000; EUR 3,210 where total balance sheet is at least EUR 350,000; payable via quarterly prepayments (10 March, 10 June, 10 September, 10 December) with final settlement on the assessment notice (rôle)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monthly late-payment interest of 0.6%; forced recovery measures (saisie-arrêt and legal privilege on business assets) initiated by the ACD collection office; administrative surcharge for underpayment.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual structural business statistics survey (STATEC SBS questionnaire)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: STATEC - Institut national de la statistique et des études économiques
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual questionnaire for the preceding reference year, normally due by 30 June of the following year; exact deadline stated on the STATEC notice
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Reminder procedure followed by administrative fines for persistent non-response under the Law of 10 July 2011 on official statistics; compliance risk is primarily administrative.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Independent statutory audit payable to a Luxembourg-approved réviseur d'entreprises agréé is compulsory when the SARL exceeds at least two of the three size criteria in each of the two most recent consecutive financial years: total balance sheet above EUR 4,400,000; net turnover above EUR 8,800,000; average workforce above 50 employees. Audit also mandatory when required by the articles of association, by court order, or for group consolidation purposes.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Luxembourg GAAP under the amended Law of 19 December 2002 on business registers and annual accounts, applying the Plan Comptable Normalisé (PCN); small entities may use the abridged (allégé) balance sheet and annex formats; IFRS as adopted by the EU is permitted only for consolidated annual accounts.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Change-driven rule: any transfer of SARL shares or any change in beneficial ownership must be filed with the RBE within 30 days of the event, supported by the updated register of members; share transfers become opposable to the company once recorded in the register of members (registre des associés). Annual rule: the SARL must file one mandatory RBE annual confirmation declaration per calendar year within 30 days after the anniversary of the initial registration, confirming that recorded UBO data remains accurate; the EUR 10 e-filing fee applies and the annual confirmation does not substitute for intermediate change reporting.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (registre des associés) - kept at the registered office and updated on each share transfer
Register of Directors and Managers (registre des administrateurs et gérants) - internal management register
Minute Book (registre des procès-verbaux) - AGM resolutions, board decisions and written shareholder resolutions
Internal UBO documentation file supporting the RBE declaration
Accounting books and supporting vouchers per Luxembourg GAAP, retained for 10 years

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: 2,000 - 3,600 USD per year (annual registered office / corporate domiciliation service with a Luxembourg fiduciary agent)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: 8,500 - 20,000 USD per year (independent statutory audit by an approved réviseur d'entreprises; not required when below the size thresholds)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 24.94% (combined corporate income tax 17% on first EUR 175,000 and 24.94% above, plus solidarity surcharge 7% on CIT)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: IP box regime (80% exemption on qualifying IP income), investment tax credit for digitalization (up to 12% of qualifying investments), R&D super deduction (up to 20% additional deduction), notional interest deduction on new equity

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 1000 (Corporate Income Tax Return) filed electronically via MyGuichet.lu or the eCDF portal
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: 31 May of the following fiscal year (extendable to 31 December upon justified request)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Company identification (name, address, RCS number, tax ID)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide full legal name, registered office, and Luxembourg tax number; if non-resident, indicate permanent establishment details

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Accounting period start and end dates
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the fiscal year covered; for non-residents, align with the PE's accounting period
Compute Luxembourg-source income attributable to the PE; apply transfer pricing adjustments

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductions and exemptions (e.g., IP box, notional interest deduction)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Claim only deductions available under Luxembourg law; provide supporting documentation

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax credits (e.g., investment tax credit, foreign tax credit)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach evidence of foreign taxes paid and treaty provisions

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net taxable income and tax computation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply progressive rates; ensure correct calculation of solidarity surcharge

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of related-party transactions and transfer pricing documentation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disclose all cross-border transactions with related parties; attach TP documentation if thresholds met

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty of EUR 100 per day up to EUR 5,000; late payment interest of 0.6% per month on unpaid tax; additional 10% penalty for gross negligence

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 25% (reduced to 0% under EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive if parent holds at least 10% for 12 months; treaty rates may apply)
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To claim treaty relief, submit Form 105 (withholding tax exemption) to the Luxembourg tax authority, attach a valid Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from the recipient's jurisdiction, and provide evidence of beneficial ownership; for EU directives, file Form 105 with the required declarations; advance rulings can be obtained for certainty
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: statutory 25%, reduced to 0% under EU Interest and Royalties Directive (if 25%+ ownership for 24 months); treaty rates typically 0-10%. Interest: statutory 25%, reduced to 0% under EU directive (if 25%+ ownership for 24 months); treaty rates typically 0-15%

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File required if related-party transactions exceed EUR 1,000,000; Master File required if group consolidated turnover exceeds EUR 50,000,000
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Luxembourg applies substance requirements under domestic law and EU anti-abuse rules; for manufacturing entities, substance is evidenced by physical presence, employees, and operational activities; ESR (Economic Substance Regulations) as per OECD standards are not directly applicable but must be demonstrated to avoid treaty abuse

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate underreporting of taxable income, falsification of accounts, or concealment of assets
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fine up to EUR 250,000 and imprisonment up to 5 years; additional tax penalties up to 100% of evaded tax
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be held personally liable for unpaid taxes if they knowingly participated in evasion; civil restitution, travel bans, and imprisonment up to 5 years

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating without real economic activity, employees, or premises; engaging in artificial arrangements to obtain tax benefits
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Denial of treaty benefits, reclassification of income, retroactive tax assessments, and penalties up to 50% of additional tax
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may face personal liability for taxes due if they fail to ensure substance; potential criminal charges for fraud

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to implement AML procedures, involvement in money laundering, or financing of terrorism
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines up to EUR 5,000,000 and imprisonment up to 5 years; revocation of business license
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors personally liable for AML breaches; travel bans, asset freezes, and imprisonment up to 5 years

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to maintain or submit transfer pricing documentation, or applying non-arm's length prices
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Adjustment of taxable income, penalties up to 50% of additional tax, and interest on underpaid tax
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be held liable for penalties if they knowingly approved non-compliant pricing; civil restitution and potential criminal charges
